product.title: DUNK
product.description: A first-person 1-6 player basketball game where every physics-based pass, block, and DUNK comes down to skill. Hit unique courts across the universe, hang out over proximity chat, or finesse your 1st-person skills in solo play. Unlock new looks, emotes, and more, to flex on your mates!
product.history: A first-person basketball game for 1-6 players in matches of 1v1 to 3v3. Hang out with friends over proximity chat or let your skills do the talking as you intercept, tackle, pass, and DUNK.

features.feature: Physics-based passing, blocking, tackling and dunking
Solo play to hone your skills
Schoolyard, jungle and moon courts with their own mechanics

product.development: In active development by Katapult Games.
product.short-description: A first-person 1-6 player basketball game where every physics-based pass, block, and DUNK comes down to skill. Hit unique courts across the universe, hang out over proximity chat, or finesse your 1st-person skills in solo play. Unlock new looks, emotes, and more, to flex on your mates!

long-descriptions.long-description: A first-person basketball game for 1-6 players in matches of 1v1 to 3v3. Hang out with friends over proximity chat or let your skills do the talking as you intercept, tackle, pass, and DUNK.

key-feature.title: Balling Out
key-feature.body:
Enjoy an easy-to-pick up but hard to master first-person basketball experience for players of all skill levels. Learn to time your shots, pick the right pass, and steal the ball, or add to the chaos and enjoy simply hanging with friends. Grow from asking “how did that go in?” to “I absolutely meant for that to happen.”
Strong teams and players will channel their inner Bulls and learn how to work together to defend and attack as a unit. (Don’t worry, we expect most of you to fall into name-calling and general chaos).

key-feature.title: The Courts Are Waiting
key-feature.body:
Pull up to courts, from the classic schoolyard to the moon, each with their own unique characteristics to master. Use the hanging vines in the jungle and make the most of low gravity on the moon to get an edge over your opponents.
Some courts may even hide further secrets worth investigating - like what exactly is that monkey waiting for in the jungle?

key-feature.title: Friendly Competition
key-feature.body:
What would a game of pick-up basketball look like without a bit of friendly banter? Proximity chat, unlockable cosmetics, and a range of emotes give you a way to flex on opponents, so long as you’re prepared to back it up on the courts and make a name for yourself.
Play however you choose online, with matches up to 3v3 available for solo players and teams. Set up a private 5v1 lobby and see just how long your friend Alex can hold on! Join our Discord to find players and a community to play with.

team.boilerplate: A small indie video game studio based in Ireland. We are Katapult Games and we build games with our community, not just for them. Driven by transparency, flexibility and a love for modern gaming trends, our mission is to create high energy multiplayer experiences that truly connect with players. We don't just want you to play our games, we want you to help us shape them. Welcome to the squad!
